instruction: Use the set square to push the three blocks into a straight, aligned row, then reset the robot arm.

arguments.note: The set square lies in front of the three cubes. I will turn the right wrist downward to grasp it without touching the cubes.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will approach the right-hand section of the set square from above, leaving its long edge available for pushing.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 28 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The ruler is diagonal beneath the wrist. I am aligning the jaws across its narrow width and approaching just above the table.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 19 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The wrist view shows the ruler offset toward the near side of the hand. I will correct the approach and make the jaws perpendicular to its edge.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 19 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The ruler is now between the open jaws but slightly off-center. I will make a small near-side correction before closing at table height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws straddle the ruler. I will close at the table-limited grasp height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The ruler is secured and all cubes remain on the table. I will slide its long edge toward the cubes, stopping short of initial contact.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The ruler has contacted the blocks and brought them into a row. I will advance only a few millimetres to seat their faces against the straight edge.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: All three cubes are ahead of the edge. I will continue a gentle five-millimetre slide to improve their common alignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will maintain the ruler flat and advance another five millimetres, letting the cubes slide rather than lift.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The middle cube is still angled slightly. I will continue the short, straight push so its face can settle against the ruler.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will nudge the straight edge forward five millimetres while keeping every cube supported by the table.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The middle cube is rotating into alignment. I will continue with another five-millimetre push.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The three near faces are nearly flush with the ruler. I will make one more small seating push.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The cubes now form a straight row with parallel faces. I will ease the ruler away without disturbing them.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The aligned cubes are stationary on the table. I will release the ruler here before returning the arm home.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The last 5 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: The ruler is released. I will lift the empty jaws clear before moving back.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The blocks remain aligned and the empty hand is clear. I will return to the initial grasp-point position, then restore its orientation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 12 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The right hand is back at its starting position. I will restore its starting orientation in manageable increments.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will continue restoring the wrist while leaving the completed row untouched.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 26 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The row remains straight and the left arm is already at origin. I will complete the right arm's return to its original pose.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 12 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.
